title: A waiting turn exposes its gate without opening SSE
description:
As a client, I want to read which gate a waiting turn is blocked on without subscribing to SSE, so that polling and reconnect logic stay honest.

Feature: Turn-scoped server-sent events

Scenario: A waiting turn exposes its gate over HTTP
  Given an empty control plane
  And tenant anthus user ryan has a channel with a named bot Researcher
  And user ryan of tenant anthus has an active turn on the channel
  When the worker posts a progress chunk and then waits on the browser gate
  Then user ryan can read the turn gate as browser without opening SSE

Also: EventBridge deadline recovery must not fail a turn that is legitimately waiting on a readiness gate.

ChatticusThinTurn-only from develop @ e4511c3. exercise --environment development exit 0: turn_waiting_for=browser; model_turn_waiting_for=browser; resume_while_stopped=409; model_resume_while_stopped=409. Deadline recovery skips legitimately waiting turns. No Fargate. No staging/production.
